subject.title: [Bug]: Regression: User-configured heartbeat prompt no longer respected

question: Should maintainers refresh the open conflicting fork PR for this heartbeat prompt regression, or close that path and sponsor a narrow same-repo replacement fix?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible on current main, but the issue has a live closing-syntax fork PR and a no-new-fix-pr routing label, so automation should not start another fix path until maintainers choose ownership.

options.title: Replace with same-repo repair
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path and sponsor one focused fix that covers custom-prompt mutation plus prompt-boundary regression tests.

options.title: Refresh the fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author or a maintainer to rebase it, add real behavior proof, and expand coverage if the transcript-marker boundary remains in scope.

options.title: Pause for owner triage
options.body: Keep the issue open without a new repair until a heartbeat prompt-boundary owner decides the exact fix shape.

recommendation.title: Replace with same-repo repair
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path and sponsor one focused fix that covers custom-prompt mutation plus prompt-boundary regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the path-hint commit and the first same-repo fix attempt for this regression.
